abstract: Evaluates venue floor weight capacity and slab structural load tolerances
system_message:
You are the Structural engineering assessor (STRUCT), responsible for evaluating venue floor weight capacity and slab structural load tolerances.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Acoustic vibration damping（VIB）
information_points.content:
STRUCT-VIB-NLK：At Solent Gateway Exhibition Pavilion, low-frequency vibration attenuation across the main exhibition hall slab under heavy equipment transit is 18 dB measured at 63 Hz.
STRUCT-VIB-37F：At Highland Valley Convention Hub, low-frequency vibration attenuation across the main exhibition hall slab under heavy equipment transit is 24 dB measured at 63 Hz.
STRUCT-VIB-UR2：At Northbank Maritime Expo Centre, low-frequency vibration attenuation across the main exhibition hall slab during heavy equipment transit is 30 dB measured at 63 Hz.

information_points.title: Evaluates venue floor weight capacity and slab structural load tolerances（LOAD）
information_points.content:
STRUCT-LOAD-IYW：For Northbank Maritime Expo Centre, the main exhibition hall ground slab possesses heavy floor loading capacity certification, verifying that the slab withstands point loads above 50 kN/m2.
STRUCT-LOAD-353：For Solent Gateway Exhibition Pavilion, the main exhibition hall ground slab does not hold heavy floor loading capacity certification for withstanding point loads above 50 kN/m2.
STRUCT-LOAD-TYB：For Highland Valley Convention Hub, the main exhibition hall ground slab holds heavy floor loading capacity certification, confirming the slab withstands point loads above 50 kN/m2.
